description: [Residential] Connect through a proxy and report the exit IP, location and optionally the Scamalytics fraud score. With max_score on a sticky or timed session, retry risky IPs in the same target location up to max_attempts. Use the returned connection only when ok is true. If no IP meets the threshold, return a tool error with status threshold_not_met and no connection credentials.

city.description: City code from residential_list_locations, for example Houston or New-York.

country.description: Two-letter country code in upper case, for example US. Leave empty for worldwide.

gateway.description: Entry gateway closest to the machine that will use the proxy. Defaults to europe.

max_attempts.description: How many sessions to try when max_score is set. Defaults to 3.

max_score.description: Highest acceptable fraud score. Implies reputation. A higher score on a sticky or timed session triggers a new session in the same location.

port.description: First port. Each extra connection uses the next port.

region.description: Numeric region code from residential_list_locations, for example the code of Texas.

reputation.description: Also look up the Scamalytics fraud score of the exit IP (0 is clean, 100 is risky). Counts toward the daily limit.

session_id.description: Letters and digits only, up to 64 characters. The same session id returns the same IP while it lasts.

session_mode.description: sticky keeps one IP while the device stays online, timed keeps it for ttl seconds, rotating changes IP on every request. Defaults to sticky.

ttl.description: Session length in seconds for timed sessions, up to 259200 (72 hours).

zip.description: ZIP or postal code. Requires country.

name: residential_check_connection
title: Check Connection Tool
